requiredBehavior: Every listed mutation must make required tests, the targeted lifecycle matrix, the complete fault matrix, and the formal evidence generator exit nonzero.

mutations.description: Skip durable authority-journal atomic write.
Persist metadata with a generation unrelated to the authority event.
Accept terminal authority metadata without the matching vault image.
Reuse requestId without mutation identity verification.
Convert an operating-system decrypt failure into a normal missing value.
Return PREPARE communication error without QUERY or ABORT.
Keep backend operational after an indeterminate COMMIT close.
Allow direct CredentialVault.set bypass.
Commit a desktop mutation without stopping and recovering the old backend owner.
Reject a supported WP3 vault instead of entering controlled migration.
Write the formal vault before a recoverable bootstrap intent.
Remove the durable migration completion marker.
Destroy the WP3 source vault when migration fails.
Close the old FD6 channel without recovering the owner transaction.
Allow new FD5 while the old owner or transaction is still active.
Treat PID equality as sufficient owner identity.
Replace real F16 child-exit evidence with a synthetic PASS.
Run desktop replacement without the application-level lease.
Continue replacement after backend stop or exit confirmation failure.
Accept a new backend owner despite FD5, FD6, generation or authority mismatch.
Remove generation binding between backend, owner session, FD6 and vault authority.
Ignore the authority digest advertised by the new backend owner.
Use a fresh requestId when retrying a committed desktop mutation.
Commit a desktop mutation after application shutdown becomes pending.
Leave a backend running after READY or runtime projection rejection.
Await the runtime projection but do not compare SQLite, AppRuntime and SecureBridge authority.
Discard an interrupted committed application operation on coordinator restart.
Return desktop mutation success without awaiting runtime authority convergence.
Release the durable application fence after rejected-owner cleanup fails.
Keep the rejected owner FD6 pipe available after containment.
Allow FAILED_SAFE to reset to IDLE while a backend owner or FD6 remains live.
Accept an already-running backend without revalidating runtime projections.
Allow FD6 PREPARE while a rejected owner remains live.
Allow desktop UI mutation while rejected-owner containment is active.

equivalentMutationPolicy: Each security property is exercised through real disk, process and protocol behavior; source-anchor mutations are supplemental and all four independent oracles must reject each mutant.
